newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Wal-Mart said raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wal-Mart said raised.

text.p: -- Smith Barney upgraded Wal-Mart Stores Inc to buy from outperform, the office of analyst Derek Johnston confirmed.
-- In research note, left calendar 1997 earnings estimate unchanged at $1.55 per share but said "have a higher degree of confidence in this estimate."
-- Cited improved inventory quality and stronger than expected comparabe store sales for February, suggesting "the first quarter is shaping up to possibly exceed consensus estimates of $0.28."
-- Said $34 price target assumes valuation in line with three year average price to earnings ratio of 19.8.
